definition_zh: 理论框架；指导研究并解释现象的一整套理论、假设与概念结构
definition_en: an organized set of theories, assumptions and concepts that guides a study and explains what it observes
core_image: 一张摊开的大图纸上，几根主梁先立稳，再把各块薄板搭到梁上，整间屋子的受力关系一眼可见
scene: 开题报告写到研究思路一节，导师要求学生先把所依据的理论体系搭清楚，再谈具体方法。 Every thesis needs a theoretical framework before the methods are chosen.
sceneCN: 这里指研究开始前先搭好的理论体系（第 1 个义项：指导研究的理论结构）；句意为每篇论文在选定方法之前都需要一个理论框架。

pos.zh: 理论框架；理论体系

collocations.zh: 以某一理论框架为基础

derivatives.zh: 由希腊语「观看、沉思」而来的名词，义为「理论；学说」
由「理论」加表示「属于……的」形容词尾构成，义为「理论的」
在形容词后加副词尾，义为「在理论上」
加表示「从事者」的名词尾，义为「理论家」
加表示「使……化」的动词尾，义为「建立理论」

senses.title: The overall theory that guides a study
senses.titleCN: 统领整项研究的理论结构
senses.definition: the organized body of theory that defines what a study looks at and how it interprets results
senses.definitionCN: 界定研究看什么、如何解释结果的成体系理论
senses.example: The theoretical framework draws on two models of learning.
senses.exampleCN: 这个理论框架借用了两种学习模型。
senses.why: A framework is a load-bearing structure, and theory supplies the beams that hold a study upright.
senses.whyCN: 框架是承重结构，而理论提供把研究撑起来的梁。

senses.title: A set of assumptions and definitions
senses.definition: the assumptions and defined terms that a study accepts before any data are collected
senses.definitionCN: 研究在收集数据之前就已接受的一组假设与界定好的术语
senses.example: Her theoretical framework treats motivation as a stable trait.
senses.exampleCN: 她的理论框架把动机视为一种稳定特质。
senses.why: Every framework begins by fixing what its words mean, just as a building begins with fixed dimensions.
senses.whyCN: 每个框架都先固定词的含义，正如建筑先固定尺寸。

senses.title: An explanatory scheme from a discipline
senses.titleCN: 来自某一学科的解释方案
senses.definition: a recognized explanatory scheme borrowed from a field such as psychology, economics or sociology
senses.definitionCN: 从心理学、经济学或社会学等领域借来的、被认可的解释方案
senses.example: The study used a sociological theoretical framework to explain voting.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究用社会学的理论框架解释投票行为。
senses.why: Disciplines keep ready-made schemes, and borrowing one gives a study an established language for its findings.
senses.whyCN: 学科各自备有成套方案，借来一套就让研究结果有了既成的解释语言。

senses.title: The theory chapter of a thesis
senses.titleCN: 学位论文中的理论章节
senses.definition: the section of a thesis that reviews and justifies the theory chosen for the project
senses.definitionCN: 学位论文中评述并论证所选理论的那一部分
senses.example: Chapter two sets out the theoretical framework in twenty pages.
senses.exampleCN: 第二章用二十页篇幅交代理论框架。
senses.why: In academic writing the abstract structure becomes a named section, so the phrase also labels a chapter.
senses.whyCN: 在学术写作里，抽象结构变成一个具名章节，因此这个词组也指一章。

senses.title: A lens for reading the data
senses.definition: the perspective through which observations are selected, sorted and given meaning
senses.definitionCN: 用来筛选、归类并赋予观察以意义的视角
senses.example: Through this theoretical framework, silence in the interviews counts as data.
senses.exampleCN: 透过这个理论框架，访谈中的沉默也算作数据。
senses.why: Theory decides what counts as relevant, which is like a lens that brings one part of the field into focus.
senses.whyCN: 理论决定什么算相关，就像镜片把视野中的一部分对焦。

senses.title: A source of testable hypotheses
senses.definition: the part of a theory that predicts relationships which the study can then test
senses.definitionCN: 理论中预测各种关系、可供研究随后检验的部分
senses.example: The theoretical framework predicts that feedback raises persistence.
senses.exampleCN: 这个理论框架预测反馈会提高坚持度。
senses.why: A theory earns its place in research by making predictions, so the framework is also a hypothesis machine.
senses.whyCN: 理论靠做出预测在研究里立足，因此框架也是一台生产假设的机器。

senses.title: The boundary of a study's claims
senses.definition: the limits that theory sets on what the study can reasonably claim
senses.definitionCN: 理论为本研究可以合理主张的范围划定的界限
senses.example: The theoretical framework limits the findings to adult learners.
senses.exampleCN: 这个理论框架把结论限定在成年学习者范围内。
senses.why: A frame holds a picture inside its edges, and theory marks how far a conclusion may travel.
senses.whyCN: 画框把画面圈在边内，理论则标出结论能走多远。

senses.title: The standard for judging fit
senses.definition: the benchmark used to decide whether findings are consistent with the theory
senses.definitionCN: 用来判断研究结果是否与理论相符的基准
senses.example: Reviewers asked whether the results fit the theoretical framework.
senses.exampleCN: 审稿人追问结果是否与理论框架相符。
senses.why: Once a scheme is adopted, it becomes a yardstick, and mismatches between results and theory become visible.
senses.whyCN: 方案一旦被采用就成为尺子，结果与理论不合之处便显现出来。

intro.en: Theoretical framework pairs a Greek word for contemplative viewing with an English word for a load-bearing structure. Theory supplies the beams; framework supplies the shape that holds them together.
intro.cn: 这个词组把希腊语中表示「沉思观看」的词，与英语中表示承重结构的词配在一起。理论提供梁，框架提供把它们拢住的形状。

items.en: Theoria meant a viewing or contemplation, especially the official viewing of a sacred rite; its deeper link to a word for sight is plausible but not certain.
items.cn: 这个词指观看或沉思，尤指对宗教仪式的正式观礼；它与表示「看」的词有联系，但这一点只是推测，并非确证。

items.en: Late Latin took the Greek adjective for «belonging to viewing» and passed it to European languages as the word for theory.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语取来这个希腊形容词，义为「与观看有关的」，再传给欧洲各语言，成为「理论」一词。

items.en: English theory appeared in the sixteenth century for a speculative scheme of knowledge, as opposed to practice.
items.cn: 英语的「理论」在十六世纪出现，指与实践相对的思辨知识体系。

items.en: Framian meant to be useful or to advance, and the related noun frame named something that gives shape and support.
items.cn: 这个古英语动词意为「有用、推进」，相关名词指给出形状与支撑的东西。

items.en: Frame and work joined in the sixteenth or seventeenth century for a supporting structure; the earliest record is uncertain.
items.cn: 「框」与「工」在十六或十七世纪合成，指起支撑作用的结构；最早记录年代不确定。

items.en: Social science fixed the two words together in the twentieth century for the theory structure that a study rests on.
items.cn: 社会科学在二十世纪把这两个词固定组合，指一项研究所依托的理论结构。

note.en: The first group belongs to the theory family or merely looks similar; the second group names other kinds of research structure.
note.cn: 第一组属于「理论」同族或只是形近；第二组指其他类型的研究结构。

entries.definition: An organized set of ideas meant to explain a class of facts.
entries.definitionCN: 指用来解释一类事实的成体系观点。

entries.definition: Concerned with theory rather than practice or measurement.
entries.definitionCN: 指关涉理论而非实践或测量的。

entries.definition: A person who builds or studies theories.
entries.definitionCN: 指建构或研究理论的人。

entries.definition: A statement proved from accepted premises; it shares the viewing root.
entries.definitionCN: 指由公认前提证明的命题；与「观看」词根同源。

entries.definition: A supporting structure, whether physical or conceptual.
entries.definitionCN: 指起支撑作用的结构，可以是实物也可以是概念。

entries.definition: The study of religion; it begins with the word for god, not for viewing.
entries.definitionCN: 指宗教学；起首是「神」的词，而非「观看」。

entries.definition: A researcher's own map of concepts and their links, rather than a borrowed theory.
entries.definitionCN: 指研究者自己绘制的概念及关系图，而非借来的理论。

entries.definition: The structure that organizes how a analysis will break a problem into parts.
entries.definitionCN: 指把问题拆成部分来分析时所依的结构。

entries.definition: A simplified representation of the variables and paths a study will examine.
entries.definitionCN: 指对研究要考察的变量与路径的简化表示。

entries.definition: A whole way of thinking shared by a field, larger than one study's framework.
entries.definitionCN: 指一个领域共有的整套思维方式，比单项研究的框架更大。

entries.definition: A specific testable prediction, narrower than a framework.
entries.definitionCN: 指具体可检验的预测，比框架窄。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the load-bearing picture and the real academic phrases around theory.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用承重结构的画面，以及围绕「理论」的真实学术搭配。

normal.en: Theory is the beam and framework is the shape: neither stands without the other.
normal.cn: 理论是梁，框架是形，两者缺一都立不住。

normal.en: A framework carries weight, so a weak theory shows up as a study that sags under its own claims.
normal.cn: 框架要承重，理论一弱，研究就会在自己的结论下塌下去。

normal.en: The phrase is standard in proposals, where it names the chapter that justifies the theory.
normal.cn: 这个词组在开题报告里是标准说法，用来指论证理论的那一章。

normal.en: A theoretical framework predicts; a conceptual framework organizes. The pair is often confused.
normal.cn: 理论框架负责预测，概念框架负责组织，两者常被混用。

normal.en: The frame around a picture decides what is inside the picture.
normal.cn: 画框决定什么在画面之内。

abstract.en: A framework is visible only when something pushes against it; theory is tested by findings that do not fit.
abstract.cn: 框架只有在被推挤时才显形，理论则靠不吻合的结果来检验。

abstract.en: Every study stands inside a frame it did not build, and the frame quietly decides what counts as evidence.
abstract.cn: 每项研究都站在一个自己没搭的框架里，这个框架悄悄决定什么算证据。

abstract.en: Beams are chosen before the room is used, which is why the theory must come before the method.
abstract.cn: 梁在使用房间之前就选好，所以理论必须先于方法。

examples.en: The paper builds its theoretical framework on two competing models of memory.
examples.cn: 这篇论文把理论框架建立在两种相互竞争的记忆模型上。

examples.en: Without a theoretical framework, the interviews produced anecdotes rather than findings.
examples.cn: 没有理论框架，这些访谈只产出轶事而不是研究发现。

examples.en: The committee asked the student to align the method with the theoretical framework.
examples.cn: 委员会要求学生让方法与理论框架保持一致。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「理论」是梁，「框架」是框：先立梁再围框，一套撑起研究的骨架就是理论框架

root: 「理论」源自希腊语 theoria「观看、沉思」，经晚期拉丁语 theoreticus 进入欧洲语言。「框架」由古英语 framian「有用、推进」与 work「工、作」合成，十六七世纪起指承重结构；两个词在二十世纪社会科学中被固定组合。最早记录年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the whole structure to its edges: the guiding theory, the assumptions, a borrowed scheme, a thesis chapter, a lens on data, a source of hypotheses, the limit of claims, and the standard of fit.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从整体走向边缘：统领理论、假设与定义、借来的解释方案、论文理论章、解读数据的镜片、假设的来源、结论的边界、契合的标准。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a frame of beams is raised first, and every later panel is fixed to those beams.
core.cn: 核心意象：先立起一副梁架，此后每一块板都固定在这副梁上。

branches.en: THE GUIDING THEORY: the borrowed scheme that decides what the study examines.
branches.cn: 统领理论：决定研究考察什么的借用方案。

branches.en: THE FIXED ASSUMPTIONS: definitions and beliefs accepted before data arrive.
branches.cn: 既定假设：在数据到来前就接受的界定与信念。

branches.en: THE WRITTEN CHAPTER: the part of a thesis that justifies the choice.
branches.cn: 成文章节：论文中论证该选择的部分。

branches.en: THE WORKING LENS: the perspective that sorts data and predicts relations.
branches.cn: 工作镜片：筛选数据并预测关系的视角。

branches.en: THE EDGE OF THE FRAME: what the study may claim and how fit is judged.
branches.cn: 框的边缘：研究可以主张什么，以及如何判断契合。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Greek-derived theory word to an Old English structure word, and both halves still carry their original pictures.
intro.cn: 这个词组把希腊来源的理论词与古英语的结构词接在一起，两半至今都带着各自的原始画面。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies theoreticus; the structure half is native English and has no Latin entry.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了「理论的」这一形容词；结构那一半是英语本族词，没有拉丁语条目。

items.example: It passed through Latin into the learned word for theory.
items.exampleCN: 它经拉丁语进入学术用语「理论」。

items.example: It gave English the adjective theoretical.
items.exampleCN: 它给英语提供了形容词「理论的」。

items.example: It marks theoretical as an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它把「理论」标为形容词。

items.example: It is the load-bearing half of the phrase.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个词组里承重的那一半。

items.example: It joins frame to form framework.
items.exampleCN: 它与「框」合成「框架」。

items.example: The earlier verb behind frame.
items.exampleCN: 这是「框」背后更早的动词。

items.example: It contrasts with theory as an organizing unit.
items.exampleCN: 它作为组织单位与「理论」相对。

items.example: It marks the neighbouring phrase conceptual framework.
items.exampleCN: 它标出邻近的「概念框架」一词。

derivatives.zh: 希腊语「观看、沉思」经拉丁语而来的名词，义为「理论」
由「理论」加形容词尾构成，义为「理论的」
加副词尾，义为「在理论上」
加从事者名词尾，义为「理论家」
加动词尾，义为「建立理论」

definition_zh: 和解；调和；使一致；对账；使顺从
definition_en: to bring people, ideas or records back into agreement after a difference
core_image: 两本账簿摊在桌上，数字一格一格对上，最后一行终于写出同一个合计
scene: 交报表前，她把发票、银行流水和台账逐笔核对，找出差了的那两笔。 She reconciled the two records before submitting the report.
sceneCN: 这里指把两套记录核对到一致（第 4 个义项：核对账目使相符）；句意为她在交报表前把两套记录对平了。图中可辨识物件：摊开的账簿、逐行核对的笔迹、写出同一合计的最后一行。

pos.zh: 和解；调和；使一致；对账

derivatives.zh: 由该动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「和解；调和；对账」
由该动词加表示倾向的形容词尾构成，义为「和解性的」
由该动词加表示施动者的名词尾构成，义为「调停者」
由否定前缀加「可调和的」构成，义为「不可调和的」
由该动词加已然词尾构成，义为「已和解的；已对平的」

senses.title: To restore a relationship
senses.definition: to bring two people or groups back to friendly relations after a quarrel
senses.definitionCN: 在争吵之后使人或群体重回友好关系
senses.example: The brothers reconciled after the funeral.
senses.exampleCN: 兄弟俩在葬礼之后和解了。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to bring back together into a council, and that is the human core of the word.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「重新召集到一处」，这正是这个词的人情内核。

senses.title: To harmonise ideas
senses.definition: to show that two apparently opposed ideas can both be accepted
senses.definitionCN: 说明两种看似对立的观点可以同时成立
senses.example: The essay reconciles scientific evidence with local belief.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章把科学证据与当地信仰调和起来。
senses.why: Ideas are brought into one council too, and reconciliation is the seating of opponents at one table.
senses.whyCN: 观点也被召进同一个议事厅，调和就是让对手坐到一张桌子旁。

senses.title: To make statements consistent
senses.definition: to make an account agree with the evidence or with another account
senses.definitionCN: 使一种说法与证据或另一种说法相符
senses.example: He could not reconcile his story with the time stamps.
senses.exampleCN: 他无法让自己的说法与时间戳对上。
senses.why: When two accounts disagree, reconciling them means finding the version that satisfies both.
senses.whyCN: 当两份叙述不一致，调和就是找出能同时满足两者的版本。

senses.title: To check financial records
senses.definition: to compare two sets of records and adjust them until they agree
senses.definitionCN: 比较两套记录并调整到相符
senses.example: The clerk reconciled the bank statement with the ledger.
senses.exampleCN: 职员把银行对账单与台账对平了。
senses.why: Accounting turned the council image into two columns that must arrive at one total.
senses.whyCN: 会计把「议事厅」的画面变成两栏必须合成一个总数的数字。

senses.title: To accept something reluctantly
senses.definition: to bring oneself to accept a difficult situation that cannot be changed
senses.definitionCN: 使自己接受一个无法改变的困难处境
senses.example: She reconciled herself to the longer commute.
senses.exampleCN: 她只好接受了更长的通勤。
senses.why: This reflexive use is a private council: the self is brought back into agreement with reality.
senses.whyCN: 这个反身用法是一场私下的议事：自我被重新与现实达成一致。

senses.title: To mediate a dispute
senses.definition: to act as a third party who brings two sides to an agreement
senses.definitionCN: 作为第三方让两边达成一致
senses.example: A retired judge reconciled the neighbours over the boundary.
senses.exampleCN: 一位退休法官就边界纠纷调解了两家邻居。
senses.why: Mediation is the verb performed on behalf of others rather than on oneself.
senses.whyCN: 调解是替别人而不是替自己行使这个动词。

senses.title: To align two datasets
senses.definition: to match two sets of data that use different formats or identifiers
senses.definitionCN: 把格式或标识不同的两套数据匹配起来
senses.example: The team reconciled the sensor logs with the maintenance records.
senses.exampleCN: 团队把传感器日志与维护记录对齐了。
senses.why: Data work inherited the accounting sense: two systems describe one reality and must be made to agree.
senses.whyCN: 数据工作继承了会计义：两个系统描述同一现实，必须被弄成一致。

senses.title: To balance competing needs
senses.definition: to find a practical arrangement that meets two demands at once
senses.definitionCN: 找到同时满足两项要求的实际安排
senses.example: The plan reconciles housing demand with the need for open land.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方案兼顾了住房需求与保留空地的需要。
senses.why: Planning is a council of demands, and reconciling them is what a plan is for.
senses.whyCN: 规划就是各种需求的议事厅，而调和它们正是方案存在的理由。

intro.en: Reconcile comes from Latin reconciliare, to bring together again, from re-, again, and conciliare, to unite, from concilium, an assembly. English took it through French.
intro.cn: 这个词来自拉丁语 reconciliare「重新聚到一起」，由 re-「再」与 conciliare「使联合」构成，而 conciliare 出自 concilium「集会」；英语经法语引入。

items.en: Concilium meant an assembly or council, the gathering of people into one body.
items.cn: 这个词意为集会或议事会，即把人聚成一个整体。

items.en: Conciliare meant to unite or to win over, and it could also mean to procure or to cause.
items.cn: 这个词意为使联合、争取过来，也可指取得或促成。

items.en: The prefix meant again or back, so reconciliare pictured a second gathering after a break.
items.cn: 前缀意为「再、回」，所以这个词的画面是破裂之后的第二次聚集。

items.en: The verb meant to restore to friendship or to bring back into agreement.
items.cn: 这个动词意为恢复友好或使重新一致。

items.en: English adopted the verb through French; the exact first date is uncertain and is usually given only as that century.
items.cn: 英语经法语采用这个动词；确切首见年代不确定，通常只给「十四世纪」。

items.en: Bookkeeping gave the verb its ledger sense, in which the two parties are two sets of figures.
items.cn: 记账给这个动词添了账簿义，其中的「两方」变成了两套数字。

note.en: The first group shares the council stem or looks close; the second group names neighbouring ideas of agreement and settlement.
note.cn: 第一组与「reconcile」共享「集会」词干或只是形近；第二组是与「一致、解决」意思相邻的说法。

entries.definition: The noun for the act of restoring agreement.
entries.definitionCN: 指恢复一致这一行为的名词。

entries.definition: An adjective for differences that cannot be settled.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指无法调和的分歧。

entries.definition: To win over or pacify, from the same council verb without the re-.
entries.definitionCN: 指安抚、争取，同出「集会」动词，只是没有表示「再」的前缀。

entries.definition: A governing assembly, from the same Latin noun but a different spelling path.
entries.definitionCN: 指议事机构，同出同一拉丁名词，但拼写路径不同。

entries.definition: Advice or a legal adviser, from a different Latin verb meaning to consult.
entries.definitionCN: 指建议或法律顾问，出自另一个表示「商议」的拉丁动词。

entries.definition: To end a dispute by agreement, the plainest verb.
entries.definitionCN: 指以协议结束争端，最朴素的说法。

entries.definition: To fix a problem or decide firmly.
entries.definitionCN: 指解决问题或下定决心。

entries.definition: To make parts fit together without conflict.
entries.definitionCN: 指使各部分协调不冲突。

entries.definition: To stand between two sides and help them agree.
entries.definitionCN: 指居于两方之间帮助他们达成一致。

entries.definition: To bring things into the same line, often used of data.
entries.definitionCN: 指把事物排到同一条线上，常用于数据。

entries.definition: To repair a relationship roughly and quickly.
entries.definitionCN: 指粗略快速地修复关系。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the council inside the word, the accountant's ledger, and the spelling trap with counsel.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用词里的「集会」、会计的账簿，以及 counsel 这个拼写陷阱。

normal.en: Concilium is a council, so reconcile is to call everyone back to one table.
normal.cn: concilium 是议事会，所以这个词就是把人都叫回一张桌子。

normal.en: The re- means again, so the word always implies a break that came first.
normal.cn: re- 意为「再」，所以这个词总暗含先前的一次破裂。

normal.en: Accountants reconcile two sets of figures until they agree.
normal.cn: 会计把两套数字对到相符为止。

normal.en: Reconcile oneself to a hard fact is a private version of the same table.
normal.cn: 让自己接受一个硬事实，是同一张桌子的私下版本。

normal.en: Council is the assembly, counsel is advice, and only council belongs here.
normal.cn: council 是议事机构，counsel 是建议，只有前者与这个词相关。

abstract.en: To reconcile is not to prove one side right; it is to build a table both can sit at.
abstract.cn: 调和不是证明某一方正确，而是造一张双方都能坐下的桌子。

abstract.en: Two true accounts can still disagree, and the work is to find why.
abstract.cn: 两份真实的叙述仍可能对不上，而工作就是找出为什么。

abstract.en: The hardest reconciliation is the one a person performs with a fact that will not move.
abstract.cn: 最难的和解，是一个人跟一个不会改变的事实之间达成的那个。

examples.en: The two countries reconciled after years of frozen relations.
examples.cn: 多年关系冻结之后，两国和解了。

examples.en: It is hard to reconcile such a claim with the published data.
examples.cn: 这样的说法很难与已发表的数据相符。

examples.en: Please reconcile the invoice total with the purchase order.
examples.cn: 请把发票总额与采购订单核对一致。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「瑞康赛尔」——两本账簿摊开，末行写出同一个数：调和、对账

root: 拉丁语 concilium「集会」→ conciliare「使联合」→ reconciliare「重新聚到一起」（re-「再」）；英语十四世纪经法语引入。与 counsel「建议」不同源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all seat two parties at one table: people, ideas, statements, records, the self, a dispute, datasets and competing needs.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在把两方请到同一张桌子：人、观点、说法、账目、自我、争端、数据集与冲突的需求。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two ledgers lie open, line by line is matched, and one total finally appears at the bottom.
core.cn: 核心意象：两本账簿摊开，逐行对上，最后一行终于写出同一个合计。

branches.en: THE TABLE IS RESET: two people or two groups are brought back to one table, sometimes by a third party.
branches.cn: 桌子被重摆：两个人或两个群体被带回同一桌，有时由第三方促成。

branches.en: THE IDEAS SHARE A ROOM: opposed views or competing needs are arranged so both can stand.
branches.cn: 观点共用一室：对立观点或冲突需求被安排到可以并存。

branches.en: THE STORY IS TESTED: a claim is checked until it fits the evidence.
branches.cn: 说法被检验：一种叙述被核到与证据相符。

branches.en: THE FIGURES MEET: ledgers or datasets are matched until one total appears.
branches.cn: 数字对上：账簿或数据集被匹配到一个总数。

branches.en: THE SELF YIELDS: a person comes to terms with what cannot be changed.
branches.cn: 自我让步：人与无法改变的事达成妥协。

intro.en: Reconcile is a Latin verb of gathering, and its pieces are the prefix of return and the noun for an assembly.
intro.cn: 这是一个表示「聚拢」的拉丁动词，其部件是「返回」的前缀与表示「集会」的名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies concilium, conciliare and reconciliare; the family is well recorded, so no part is marked uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了 concilium、conciliare、reconciliare；这一族有清楚记录，没有哪一部分标为存疑。

items.example: The noun is the room where the parties meet.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是各方会面的那个房间。

items.example: The verb names the act of bringing together.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词指把人聚到一起的动作。

items.example: It marks the second gathering after a break.
items.exampleCN: 它标出破裂后的第二次聚集。

items.example: The verb carried both the human and the agreement senses.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词兼有人际与一致两种意义。

items.example: The noun supplied the English word for the process.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词提供了英语中表示过程的名词。

items.example: It forms reconciliation.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 reconciliation。

items.example: It forms reconciliatory.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 reconciliatory。

items.example: It forms irreconcilable with an assimilated r.
items.exampleCN: 它与同化的 r 一起构成 irreconcilable。

items.example: It forms the adjective for what can be settled.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示「可调和的」形容词。

derivatives.zh: 由该动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「和解；调和；对账」
由该动词加表示倾向的形容词尾构成，义为「和解性的」
由否定前缀加「可调和的」构成，义为「不可调和的」
由该动词加表示施动者的名词尾构成，义为「调停者」

definition_zh: 保护；防护；保护措施；保护区
definition_en: the state or act of being kept safe from harm, or a measure that keeps something safe
core_image: 一把撑开的伞把雨挡在头顶之外，伞骨下是一小片干的区域
scene: 举报人担心遭到报复，于是向监察机构求助。 The new law offers protection for whistle-blowers who report waste.
sceneCN: 这里 protection 指「法律提供的保护措施」（第 2 个义项：由制度或规则提供的安全保障，使某人免受伤害或报复）；句意为新法律为举报浪费行为的吹哨人提供保护。图中可辨识物件：法律文本、举报信封、监察机构门牌、撑开的伞；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 保护；防护；保护措施；保护区（可数或不可数）

derivatives.zh: 保护；防护
保护的；防护的
保护者；防护装置
保护主义
保护主义者；保护主义的

senses.title: Physical shielding from harm
senses.definition: the state of being covered or guarded so that harm cannot reach
senses.definitionCN: 被覆盖或看守、使伤害无法到达的状态
senses.example: The umbrella offered little protection against the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 那把伞对风几乎起不到防护作用。
senses.why: The Latin noun named a covering; the modern sense keeps that image of something placed between a person and a threat.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁名词命名一层遮盖；现代义保留「把某物置于人与威胁之间」的意象。

senses.title: Legal or institutional safeguard
senses.definition: a rule, law or arrangement that keeps a person or group safe from harm or retaliation
senses.definitionCN: 使个人或群体免受伤害或报复的规则、法律或安排
senses.example: The new law offers protection for whistle-blowers who report waste.
senses.exampleCN: 新法律为举报浪费行为的吹哨人提供保护。
senses.why: The law takes the place of the umbrella and stands between a person and a threat.
senses.whyCN: 法律替代雨伞，立在人与其威胁之间。

senses.title: Environmental conservation
senses.definition: measures taken to keep ecosystems, species or resources from damage
senses.definitionCN: 为防止生态系统、物种或资源受损而采取的措施
senses.example: The reserve was created for the protection of nesting turtles.
senses.exampleCN: 这个保护区是为保护筑巢海龟而设立的。
senses.why: Nature cannot hold an umbrella, so a reserve is built around it.
senses.whyCN: 自然无法自己撑伞，于是围绕它建立保护区。

senses.title: Social security against hardship
senses.definition: public arrangements that shield people from poverty, illness or unemployment
senses.definitionCN: 使人们免受贫困、疾病或失业的公共安排
senses.example: Social protection kept the family afloat after the layoff.
senses.exampleCN: 失业后，社会保障让这个家庭撑了下来。
senses.why: Hardship is a threat, so public arrangements are built as a cover.
senses.whyCN: 困境是一种威胁，于是公共安排被搭成遮盖。

senses.title: Safeguarding of personal data
senses.definition: rules and technical measures that keep personal information from misuse
senses.definitionCN: 防止个人信息被滥用的规则与技术措施
senses.example: Data protection requires consent before sharing.
senses.exampleCN: 数据保护要求在共享前取得同意。
senses.why: Information can be harmed, so rules form a layer around it.
senses.whyCN: 信息会受损，于是规则在它周围形成一层。

senses.title: Trade protection for domestic producers
senses.titleCN: 对本国生产者的贸易保护
senses.definition: tariffs or quotas that shield local industries from foreign competition
senses.definitionCN: 使本地产业免受外国竞争的关税或配额
senses.example: The minister argued for temporary protection of the steel sector.
senses.exampleCN: 部长主张对钢铁行业实行临时保护。
senses.why: A market under foreign competition is shielded like a town under attack.
senses.whyCN: 面对外国竞争的市场像受攻击的城镇一样被遮蔽。

senses.title: A protected area
senses.definition: a place legally set aside where wildlife or a site is shielded from development
senses.definitionCN: 依法划出、使野生动物或遗址免受开发的地方
senses.example: The reef is a marine protection where anchoring is banned.
senses.exampleCN: 这片珊瑚礁是一处禁止下锚的海洋保护区。
senses.why: When protection is fixed to a place, the abstract noun becomes a mapped area.
senses.whyCN: 当保护固定在某个地点，抽象名词就变成地图上的区域。

senses.title: Gear worn against injury
senses.definition: equipment worn to absorb impact or prevent injury in sport or work
senses.definitionCN: 在运动或工作中吸收冲击、防止受伤的装备
senses.example: Knee protection is compulsory on the course.
senses.exampleCN: 这条赛道上必须佩戴护膝。
senses.why: Padding is the umbrella worn on the body.
senses.whyCN: 护具是穿在身上的伞。

intro.en: Protection comes from Latin protectio 'a covering, defence', from protegere 'to cover in front', through French protection. The word is recorded in English from the fourteenth century.
intro.cn: protection 经法语 protection 来自拉丁 protectio「遮盖、防御」，后者出自 protegere「在前面遮盖」。英语自 14 世纪有记录。

items.en: Tegere 'to cover' gives the family its core image of a roof or shield over something.
items.cn: tegere「覆盖」给该词族提供核心意象：某物上方的屋顶或盾牌。

items.en: Protegere 'to cover in front, shield' added pro- 'before' to tegere.
items.cn: protegere「在前面遮盖、屏蔽」在 tegere 前加上 pro-「在前」。

items.en: Protectio named the covering or the act of shielding; its stem supplies protection and protector.
items.cn: protectio 命名遮盖或屏蔽行为；其词干提供 protection 与 protector。

items.en: Old French protection passed into English in the 1300s, first in legal and military contexts.
items.cn: 古法语 protection 于 14 世纪进入英语，最初用于法律与军事语境。

items.en: Environmental, data and social protection are nineteenth- and twentieth-century extensions of the legal sense.
items.cn: 环境、数据与社会保护是 19、20 世纪从法律义延伸出来的用法。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the earliest English use is not precisely dated and the fourteenth-century figure is approximate. The Latin protegere and protectio layers are secure.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：最早的英语使用没有精确年代，14 世纪之数为约数；拉丁 protegere 与 protectio 这两层可靠。

note.en: Group one separates the noun from the verb, adjective and agent of the family; group two separates forms of safeguarding by scope.
note.cn: 第一组区分该名词与同族动词、形容词、施动者；第二组按范围区分各类保障。

entries.definition: The adjective describing a guarding quality; protection is the thing provided.
entries.definitionCN: 描述防护性质的形容词；protection 是被提供的东西。

entries.definition: One who or that which protects; protection is the state or measure, not the agent.
entries.definitionCN: 指保护者或防护装置；protection 是状态或措施，不是施动者。

entries.definition: The action of shielding; protection is the resulting state or the arrangement.
entries.definitionCN: 指屏蔽动作；protection 是结果状态或安排。

entries.definition: Specific safeguards, as in legal protections; the singular is usually the general state.
entries.definitionCN: 指具体保障措施，如法律保护条款；单数多为一般状态。

entries.definition: Resistance to a specific attack; protection is broader and includes prevention and care.
entries.definitionCN: 指对具体攻击的抵抗；protection 更宽，包含预防与照料。

entries.definition: The condition of being safe; protection is the measure that produces it.
entries.definitionCN: 指安全的状态；protection 是产生该状态的措施。

entries.definition: Careful management to prevent loss of natural or cultural resources; it is one form of protection.
entries.definitionCN: 指防止自然或文化资源流失的谨慎管理；是保护的一种形式。

entries.definition: Keeping a person in official care; protection can be legal without detention.
entries.definitionCN: 指由官方照管某人；protection 可以是法律性的而不涉及拘留。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin noun of covering, the real family, and the collocations of law, environment and data.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁「遮盖」名词、真实词族，以及法律、环境与数据领域的固定搭配。

normal.en: protegere 'cover in front' + -ion: the state of being covered.
normal.cn: protegere「在前面遮盖」+ -ion：被遮盖的状态。

normal.en: The family runs protect, protection, protective, protector, protectionism.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 protect、protection、protective、protector、protectionism。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: environmental protection, data protection, legal protection.
normal.cn: 固定搭配有 environmental protection、data protection、legal protection。

normal.en: The noun is countable when it means specific measures.
normal.cn: 指具体措施时，这个名词可数。

normal.en: One umbrella covers rain, law, reefs and knees.
normal.cn: 一把伞同时覆盖雨、法律、珊瑚礁与膝盖。

abstract.en: Picture an umbrella holding a dry circle open in a downpour.
abstract.cn: 想象一把伞在暴雨中撑开一小片干燥的圆。

abstract.en: Picture a statute standing between a witness and a threat.
abstract.cn: 想象一条法规立在证人与威胁之间。

abstract.en: Picture a reef marked off by buoys so that no anchor can fall.
abstract.cn: 想象一片珊瑚礁被浮标圈起，任何锚都落不下去。

examples.en: The helmet gives reliable protection against a fall.
examples.cn: 头盔能在摔倒时提供可靠的保护。

examples.en: The park was declared a protection for the last wild herd.
examples.cn: 这座公园被宣布为最后一群野生兽群的保护区。

examples.en: Consumer protection laws require clear labelling.
examples.cn: 消费者保护法要求标示清楚。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「protect（保护）+ -ion（状态）」——被护住的状态 → 保护；防护

root: 拉丁 pro-「在前」+ tegere「覆盖」→ protegere「在前面遮盖」→ protectio「遮盖、防御」→ 法语 protection → 英语 protection。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses share one umbrella: rain over a head, law over a witness, rules over a reef, welfare over a family, consent over data, a tariff over a mill, a reserve over turtles, and padding over a knee.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享同一把伞：替头顶挡雨、替证人挡法外报复、替珊瑚礁挡开发、替家庭挡困境、替数据挡滥用、替工厂挡竞争、替海龟挡侵扰、替膝盖挡冲击。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open umbrella holding a small dry circle inside a downpour.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把撑开的伞在暴雨中守住一小片干燥的圆。

branches.en: PHYSICAL COVER: umbrellas, helmets and padding take the blow.
branches.cn: 物理遮盖：伞、头盔与护具承受冲击。

branches.en: INSTITUTIONAL COVER: law, welfare and consent rules stand in for the umbrella.
branches.cn: 制度遮盖：法律、福利与同意规则替代雨伞。

branches.en: CONSERVATION: measures that keep ecosystems from damage.
branches.cn: 保护措施：防止生态系统受损的行动。

branches.en: TRADE COVER: tariffs shield producers from competition.
branches.cn: 贸易遮盖：关税使生产者免受竞争。

branches.en: PLACE: protection becomes a bounded area on a map.
branches.cn: 地点：保护变成地图上一块有边界的地方。

intro.en: Protection is a Latin action noun in -io built on the protegere stem; English adds further suffixes for agent, quality and doctrine.
intro.cn: protection 是由 protegere 词干加 -io 构成的拉丁动作名词；英语再加后缀表示施动者、性质与主义。

latinIntro.en: Latin protegere, protectio and tectus carry the covering image into English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 protegere、protectio 与 tectus 把「遮盖」意象带入英语。

items.example: The levee protects the town.
items.exampleCN: 堤坝保护着这座镇。

items.example: Protection from the sun matters at noon.
items.exampleCN: 正午防晒很重要。

items.example: Protective gloves are worn here.
items.exampleCN: 这里要戴防护手套。

items.example: The treaty made the state a protector.
items.exampleCN: 条约使该国成为保护者。

items.meaning: a policy of shielding domestic industry
items.example: Protectionism raises prices at home.
items.exampleCN: 保护主义抬高国内价格。

items.meaning: one who favours such a policy
items.example: The protectionist blocked the treaty.
items.exampleCN: 那名保护主义者阻挠了条约。

items.example: Environmental protection is written into the charter.
items.exampleCN: 环境保护被写进章程。

items.example: Data protection rules limit sharing.
items.exampleCN: 数据保护规则限制共享。

items.meaning: a legal order to keep someone safe
items.meaningCN: 保护某人安全的法院命令
items.example: A protection order was served that night.
items.exampleCN: 当晚送达了一份保护令。

definition_zh: 投资组合；作品集；公文包；部长职位
definition_en: a collection of investments or works, or a case for carrying papers
core_image: 一只打开的文件夹，里面夹着分属不同领域的纸张
scene: 投资顾问把客户的资金分散到股票、债券与房产基金，随后摊开文件展示整份组合的年度表现。 Her portfolio holds a mix of bonds, shares and property funds.
sceneCN: 这里指「投资组合」，对应第 1 个义项：一个人或机构持有的全部投资；句意为她的组合包含债券、股票与房产基金。画面要点：摊开的文件夹、饼状配置图、年度报表。

pos.zh: 投资组合；作品集；公文包；部长职位；（职责）范围

derivatives.zh: 投资组合经理
组合投资；证券投资
（基金）持股公司；投资组合内公司
对开页；页码；文件夹

senses.title: A collection of investments
senses.definition: the full set of investments held by a person or institution
senses.definitionCN: 个人或机构持有的全部投资
senses.example: The fund rebalanced its portfolio in June.
senses.exampleCN: 该基金在六月调整了投资组合。
senses.why: The word for a case of papers becomes a word for a collection of financial claims: the case holds many sheets, and the investor holds many positions.
senses.whyCN: 原本指装纸的文件夹，转而指一叠金融主张的集合：文件包装许多纸，投资者握有许多头寸。

senses.title: A collection of works
senses.definition: a selection of an artist's or designer's work used to show their ability
senses.definitionCN: 艺术家或设计师用来展示能力的作品选辑
senses.example: She sent her portfolio to three design schools.
senses.exampleCN: 她把作品集寄给了三所设计学校。
senses.why: This keeps the literal case: a folder of samples carried to a meeting, where the collection itself is the argument.
senses.whyCN: 这里保留了字面的文件夹：一叠样张被带到会面现场，合集本身就是论据。

senses.title: A case for carrying papers
senses.definition: a flat case used to carry loose papers, drawings or documents
senses.definitionCN: 用来装散页、图纸或文件的扁平提包
senses.example: He left the meeting with a heavy portfolio.
senses.exampleCN: 他带着一只沉重的公文包离开会场。
senses.why: This is the original object: a portable leaf-holder, from which every metaphorical collection sense grows.
senses.whyCN: 这是原本的物件：一只可携带的「装纸器」，所有比喻性的合集义都由它生长出来。

senses.title: A minister's office
senses.definition: the position and duties of a government minister
senses.definitionCN: 政府部长的职位与职务
senses.example: She was given the education portfolio.
senses.exampleCN: 她获得了教育部长一职。
senses.why: A minister carries a bundle of responsibilities as if in a case, so the container comes to mean the office held.
senses.whyCN: 部长像提着一只箱子那样承担一束职责，于是容器转而指所担任的职位。

senses.title: A range of responsibilities
senses.definition: the set of duties assigned to one person or team
senses.definitionCN: 分配给一个人或团队的一整套职责
senses.example: Customer service is now part of his portfolio.
senses.exampleCN: 客户服务现在属于他的职责范围。
senses.why: The office sense is generalized: any bundle of tasks can be a portfolio because it is a collection held by one owner.
senses.whyCN: 职位义被一般化：任何一束任务都能叫 portfolio，因为它是由一个主体持有的一组合集。

senses.title: An educational portfolio
senses.definition: a curated collection of a student's work used for assessment
senses.definitionCN: 为评估而整理的学生作品合集
senses.example: The course is graded through a portfolio.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课通过作品档案来评分。
senses.why: Assessment shifts from a single test to a carried collection, so the folder becomes evidence of learning over time.
senses.whyCN: 评估从单次考试转为一叠随身作品，文件夹于是成了长期学习的证据。

senses.title: A company's product range
senses.definition: the set of products or brands a company offers
senses.definitionCN: 一家公司提供的产品与品牌总体
senses.example: The firm sold its older brands to simplify its portfolio.
senses.exampleCN: 该公司出售较老的品牌以精简产品组合。
senses.why: Business treats its offerings as holdings to be balanced, so the investment-collection sense is applied to goods.
senses.whyCN: 企业把所售之物当作需要平衡的持有项，投资合集的义项于是被用到商品上。

senses.title: A collection of projects
senses.definition: a managed set of projects or assets considered together
senses.definitionCN: 被放在一起管理的一批项目或资产
senses.example: The office manages a portfolio of rural road projects.
senses.exampleCN: 该办公室管理着一批乡村道路项目。
senses.why: Any set of undertakings can be balanced like investments, so the word extends from money to work in progress.
senses.whyCN: 任何一束事业都能像投资那样被平衡，于是这个词从资金扩展到进行中的工作。

intro.en: Portfolio is an Italian compound meaning a case for carrying sheets, built from a verb for carrying and a word for a leaf. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: portfolio 是意大利语复合词，意为装纸张的提包，由一个表示「携带」的动词与一个表示「纸页」的词构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Portare meant to carry, and it supplies the first half of the compound and words such as portable and transport.
items.cn: portare 意为携带，提供复合词的前半，也是 portable、transport 等词的来源。

items.en: Folium meant a leaf and also a sheet of paper, which is why a folio is a page and foliage is leafage.
items.cn: folium 意为树叶，也指纸页，所以 folio 指对开页，foliage 指枝叶。

items.en: The Italian compound joined the verb and the noun to name a case in which loose sheets were carried.
items.cn: 意大利语把这个动词与名词合起来，指用来携带散页的提包。

items.en: English borrowed the word through French forms and used it for a minister's case of state papers, then for the office itself.
items.cn: 英语经法语形式借入这个词，先指部长装公文的提包，再指职位本身。

items.en: Investors began to speak of the set of holdings they carried as a portfolio, turning the container into the collection.
items.cn: 投资者开始把所持有的一整套资产称为 portfolio，容器于是变成了合集本身。

note.en: The first group contains words built on the same carrying or leaf parts; the second group names other kinds of collection.
note.cn: 第一组是建立在同一个「携带」或「纸页」成分上的词；第二组是其他类型的合集。

entries.definition: A leaf of paper or a book made of large sheets; it is the sheet itself, not the case that carries it.
entries.definitionCN: 一张纸页或由大张纸装成的书；它是纸页本身，不是装它的提包。

entries.definition: Able to be carried easily; it shares the first element but says nothing about a collection.
entries.definitionCN: 便于携带的；共享第一个成分，但与合集无关。

entries.definition: A harbour or a wine, from Latin portus and portare respectively; only the wine sense shares the carrying verb.
entries.definitionCN: 港口或葡萄酒，分别出自拉丁语的不同词；只有葡萄酒义共享「携带」动词。

entries.definition: A travelling case, and later a word made by blending two words; it is a case, but not the paper-holder.
entries.definitionCN: 旅行箱，后指由两个词混合成的新词；它是箱子，但不是装纸的夹子。

entries.definition: Any set of things gathered together; portfolio is a specialized collection that is managed or assessed.
entries.definitionCN: 任何聚集起来的一批东西；portfolio 是被管理或被评估的专门合集。

entries.definition: The assets a person or fund owns; holdings is more concrete, while portfolio stresses the set as a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 个人或基金拥有的资产；holdings 更具体，portfolio 强调整套。

entries.definition: A flat case for carrying documents; it is the everyday object, while portfolio is the older Italian loan for the same item.
entries.definitionCN: 装文件的扁平提包；它是日常物件，portfolio 是同一物件的较早意大利语借词。

entries.definition: A file of papers about one person or case; it is a collection of documents, not of investments or works.
entries.definitionCN: 关于某人或某案的一叠文件；它是文件合集，不是投资或作品合集。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Italian parts meaning carry and leaf, real compounds and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的意大利语成分「携带」与「纸页」、真实复合词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Portare means carry and folium means leaf or sheet, so a portfolio is a sheet-carrier.
normal.cn: 前一半意为携带，后一半意为纸页，所以 portfolio 就是装纸页的器物。

normal.en: The case came first, the collection came later: investors now carry positions instead of papers.
normal.cn: 先有器物，后有合集：投资者如今携带的是头寸而不是纸页。

normal.en: A minister's portfolio is a bundle of duties carried as if in a case.
normal.cn: 部长的 portfolio 是一束像装在箱子里那样随身承担的职责。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the finance sense: investment portfolio, portfolio manager, loan portfolio.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出金融义：投资组合、组合经理、贷款组合。

normal.en: Art and education keep the older folder sense: an art portfolio and an assessment portfolio.
normal.cn: 艺术与教育保留了较早的文件夹义：作品集与学习档案。

abstract.en: Picture an open case of sheets, each sheet a different kind of claim.
abstract.cn: 想象一只打开的文件箱，每张纸都是不同种类的主张。

abstract.en: Picture the case shrinking until it is only the set of claims, no paper at all.
abstract.cn: 想象箱子不断缩小，最后只剩下那套主张，连纸也没有了。

abstract.en: Picture the same shape reappearing as a range of products or a bundle of duties.
abstract.cn: 想象同一个形状再次出现，成为一组产品或一束职责。

examples.en: A diversified portfolio can survive a single bad year.
examples.cn: 分散的投资组合能挺过单个糟糕年份。

examples.en: The designer revised her portfolio before the interview.
examples.cn: 设计师在面试前修改了作品集。

examples.en: He carried a leather portfolio under his arm.
examples.cn: 他腋下夹着一只皮制公文包。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「随身携带的一叠纸」——把各种资产像纸页一样装进同一只夹子 → 投资组合

root: 意大利语 portafoglio「装纸的提包」，由 portare「携带」（拉丁语 portare）与 foglio「纸页」（拉丁语 folium）构成；后由「携带的文件」引申为一人所持的一整套投资、作品或职责。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses start from a case of sheets and end with any managed collection: investments, artworks, duties, student work, products and projects.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一只装纸的提包出发，最终落在任何被管理的合集：投资、作品、职责、学生作业、产品与项目。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open case of loose sheets, each sheet a different claim.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只打开的文件箱，散页各代表不同的主张。

branches.en: SET OF CLAIMS: the carried papers become a set of financial positions watched as one.
branches.cn: 一套主张：随身携带的纸变成一整套被整体关注的投资头寸。

branches.en: SET OF WORKS AND GOODS: art samples and product ranges are held together for display or balance.
branches.cn: 作品与商品合集：艺术样张与产品线被放在一起展示或平衡。

branches.en: THE CASE ITSELF: the literal object that every other sense borrows from.
branches.cn: 器物本身：其他所有义项都借用这个字面物件。

branches.en: OFFICE AND DUTIES: a bundle of state papers becomes the minister's office, then any range of responsibilities.
branches.cn: 职位与职责：一束公文先变成部长职位，再泛指任何职责范围。

branches.en: ASSESSED AND MANAGED SETS: a student's file and a project group are collections run as a whole.
branches.cn: 被评估与管理的合集：学生学习档案与项目群都是作为整体运营的合集。

intro.en: Portfolio is a borrowed Italian compound, and its parts remain visible in words about carrying and about sheets of paper.
intro.cn: portfolio 是借入的意大利语复合词，其组成部分在表示「携带」与「纸页」的词里仍然可见。

latinIntro.en: The two Latin sources are portare for carrying and folium for a leaf or sheet; both produced families of English words.
latinIntro.cn: 两个拉丁来源分别是表示携带的 portare 与表示树叶或纸页的 folium，两者都产生了英语词族。

items.example: He set the portfolio on the table.
items.exampleCN: 他把公文包放在桌上。

items.example: The two portfolios overlap in energy.
items.exampleCN: 这两个组合在能源上重叠。

items.example: The bank ran a portfolio-wide review.
items.exampleCN: 银行做了全组合审查。

items.meaning: the person who runs a set of investments
items.example: The portfolio manager shifted into bonds.
items.exampleCN: 组合经理转向了债券。

items.meaning: grading based on a collected body of work

items.meaningCN: 携带，如运输一词中的成分

definition_zh: 核糖核酸；传递遗传信息的核酸；核糖核酸类分子
definition_en: ribonucleic acid, a single-stranded nucleic acid that carries, translates or regulates genetic instructions
core_image: 实验室里一段单链从模板上被抄下，随后离开核区去组装蛋白
scene: 实验室里一段单链从模板上被抄下，随后离开核区去组装蛋白。 RNA copies a stretch of DNA and carries that message out of the nucleus.
sceneCN: 这里取第 1 个义项（核糖核酸分子）；句意为核糖核酸抄下一段脱氧核糖核酸，并把这条信息带出细胞核。

pos.zh: 名词缩写：核糖核酸；遗传信息的传递与调控分子

derivatives.zh: 由缩写加表示「酶」的词尾构成，义为「核糖核酸酶」
由表示「信使」的成分与缩写复合而成，义为「信使核糖核酸」
由表示「核糖体」的成分与缩写复合而成，义为「核糖体核糖核酸」
由表示「转运」的成分与缩写复合而成，义为「转运核糖核酸」
由缩写与「以……为基础」成分复合而成，义为「基于核糖核酸的」
由缩写与「结合」成分复合而成，义为「结合核糖核酸的」
由缩写与表示「干扰」的成分复合而成，义为「核糖核酸干扰」

senses.title: The single-stranded molecule
senses.definition: the nucleic acid built from ribose, phosphate and bases, usually single-stranded
senses.definitionCN: 指由核糖、磷酸与碱基构成、通常为单链的核酸
senses.example: RNA is usually single-stranded, unlike DNA.
senses.exampleCN: 核糖核酸通常是单链，与脱氧核糖核酸不同。
senses.why: The extra oxygen in its sugar is the only chemical difference, but it changes the molecule's behaviour.
senses.whyCN: 其糖上多出的一个氧原子是唯一的化学差别，却改变了分子的行为。

senses.title: Messenger RNA
senses.definition: the transcript copied from a gene and read by the ribosome
senses.definitionCN: 指从基因抄下、由核糖体阅读的转录本
senses.example: Messenger RNA carries the recipe from the gene to the ribosome.
senses.exampleCN: 信使核糖核酸把配方从基因送到核糖体。
senses.why: The molecule's main everyday role is to move a message, not to keep it.
senses.whyCN: 这个分子日常的主要角色是搬运信息，而不是保存信息。

senses.title: The machinery of translation
senses.titleCN: 翻译机器中的核糖核酸
senses.definition: ribosomal and transfer RNA that build proteins from the message
senses.definitionCN: 指按信息建造蛋白质的核糖体核糖核酸与转运核糖核酸
senses.example: Transfer RNA brings the matching amino acid to the ribosome.
senses.exampleCN: 转运核糖核酸把对应的氨基酸送到核糖体。
senses.why: Some RNA is not a message but a tool, part of the factory itself.
senses.whyCN: 有些核糖核酸不是信息，而是工具，是工厂本身的一部分。

senses.title: A viral genome
senses.definition: the genetic material of viruses that store their instructions as RNA
senses.definitionCN: 指以核糖核酸储存遗传指令的病毒所带的遗传物质
senses.example: The influenza virus stores its genome as RNA.
senses.exampleCN: 流感病毒以核糖核酸储存基因组。
senses.why: Viruses show that DNA is not the only possible archive.
senses.whyCN: 病毒说明脱氧核糖核酸并非唯一可能的档案。

senses.title: The RNA world hypothesis
senses.definition: the proposed early stage of life in which RNA both stored information and catalysed reactions
senses.definitionCN: 指生命早期阶段的一种假说，认为核糖核酸同时储存信息并催化反应
senses.example: The RNA world idea explains how catalysis and inheritance could start together.
senses.exampleCN: 核糖核酸世界的想法解释了催化与遗传如何同时起步。
senses.why: One molecule doing two jobs is simpler than two molecules doing one each.
senses.whyCN: 一个分子兼两职，比两个分子各司一职更简单。

senses.title: RNA interference and regulation
senses.definition: small RNAs that switch genes off or adjust how much product is made
senses.definitionCN: 指关闭基因或调节产物数量的小型核糖核酸
senses.example: RNA interference can silence a gene without changing its sequence.
senses.exampleCN: 核糖核酸干扰能在不改变序列的情况下关闭一个基因。
senses.why: The molecule is also a control signal, not merely a courier.
senses.whyCN: 这个分子也是控制信号，而不只是信差。

senses.title: RNA vaccines and therapeutics
senses.definition: medical products that deliver an RNA message so the body makes a protein itself
senses.definitionCN: 指递送核糖核酸信息、让身体自行制造蛋白质的医疗产品
senses.example: The RNA vaccine instructs cells to make a harmless viral protein.
senses.exampleCN: 核糖核酸疫苗指示细胞制造一种无害的病毒蛋白。
senses.why: If the body can read the message, the message can be the medicine.
senses.whyCN: 只要身体能读这条信息，信息本身就可以成为药物。

senses.title: The spelled-out chemical name
senses.definition: the full name ribonucleic acid, used when the abbreviation is defined
senses.definitionCN: 指解释缩写时使用的全称「核糖核酸」
senses.example: The glossary expands RNA on first use.
senses.exampleCN: 术语表在首次出现时展开核糖核酸的全称。
senses.why: Abbreviations need one clear expansion before they can travel.
senses.whyCN: 缩写需要先有一次清楚展开，才能通行。

intro.en: RNA abbreviates ribonucleic acid. Nucleic comes from Latin nucleus, a kernel; ribo refers to ribose, the sugar in the chain; acid comes from Latin acidus, sour. The initials became standard in the mid-twentieth century, and the exact first use is uncertain. The molecule differs from DNA by one oxygen atom in its sugar.
intro.cn: 这个缩写展开为「核糖核酸」：其中「核酸」出自拉丁语 nucleus「核、果核」，「核糖」指链中的糖，「酸」出自拉丁语 acidus「酸的」。首字母缩写在二十世纪中期成为通用写法，确切首见时间不确定。它与脱氧核糖核酸的差别在于糖上少了一个氧原子。

items.en: Nucleus meant a kernel, and the acid of the cell nucleus took its name.
items.cn: 这个词意为果核，细胞核中的那种酸便由此得名。

items.en: The phosphorus-rich acid isolated from cell nuclei was named after the nucleus.
items.cn: 从细胞核中分离出的富磷酸被按「核」命名。

items.en: The five-carbon sugar in the chain supplied the ribo- element.
items.cn: 链中的五碳糖提供了「核糖」这一成分。

items.en: The initials replaced the full chemical name as the molecule's roles became clear; the precise first use is uncertain.
items.cn: 随着分子的各种作用逐渐清楚，首字母缩写取代了化学全称；确切首见时间不确定。

items.en: The discovery of a short-lived transcript gave RNA a verb-like role: carrying a message.
items.cn: 短寿命转录本的发现赋予核糖核酸一个动词式的角色：传递信息。

items.en: The hypothesis that early life relied on RNA was named in the later twentieth century; the exact naming date is uncertain.
items.cn: 早期生命依赖核糖核酸的假说在二十世纪后期得名，确切命名年份不确定。

note.en: The first group shares the abbreviation shape; the second group names its types and the things it interacts with.
note.cn: 第一组共享缩写形式；第二组是它的类型与相互作用的对象。

entries.definition: Deoxyribonucleic acid, the double-stranded archive of inheritance.
entries.definitionCN: 脱氧核糖核酸，双链的遗传档案。

entries.definition: Messenger RNA, the transcript read by ribosomes.
entries.definitionCN: 信使核糖核酸，被核糖体阅读的转录本。

entries.definition: Ribosomal RNA, part of the protein-building factory.
entries.definitionCN: 核糖体核糖核酸，蛋白质工厂的组成部分。

entries.definition: Transfer RNA, which brings amino acids into place.
entries.definitionCN: 转运核糖核酸，把氨基酸送到位置。

entries.definition: An enzyme that breaks RNA down.
entries.definitionCN: 指分解核糖核酸的酶。

entries.definition: The RNA copy made from a gene.
entries.definitionCN: 指从基因抄出的核糖核酸副本。

entries.definition: The chemical family that includes both DNA and RNA.
entries.definitionCN: 指包括脱氧核糖核酸与核糖核酸的化学家族。

entries.definition: The particle that reads mRNA and builds protein.
entries.definitionCN: 指阅读信使核糖核酸并建造蛋白质的颗粒。

entries.definition: A three-base group that specifies one amino acid.
entries.definitionCN: 指规定一个氨基酸的三个碱基组合。

entries.definition: A particle that may carry its instructions as RNA.
entries.definitionCN: 指可能以核糖核酸携带遗传指令的颗粒。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations unpack the initials and the jobs the molecule does.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想把首字母展开，并记住这个分子承担的几项工作。

normal.en: Ribose plus nucleic plus acid: the sugar is the one with its oxygen kept.
normal.cn: 核糖加核酸加酸：这种糖保留着那个氧原子。

normal.en: DNA stores, RNA carries; the courier leaves the nucleus.
normal.cn: 脱氧核糖核酸储存，核糖核酸搬运；信差离开细胞核。

normal.en: mRNA is the message, tRNA the delivery, rRNA the factory floor.
normal.cn: 信使是信息，转运是送货，核糖体是车间地面。

normal.en: Some viruses keep their whole genome as RNA.
normal.cn: 有些病毒把整个基因组存成核糖核酸。

normal.en: An RNA vaccine gives the body a message instead of a product.
normal.cn: 核糖核酸疫苗给身体的是信息，而不是成品。

abstract.en: Storing and doing need not be separate jobs; early life may have used one molecule for both.
abstract.cn: 储存与执行不必分开，早期生命也许用一个分子兼做两事。

abstract.en: A message that can silence a gene is also a form of control.
abstract.cn: 能关闭基因的信息，也是一种控制方式。

abstract.en: The shortest-lived copy can be the most important one.
abstract.cn: 寿命最短的副本，可能是最重要的那一份。

examples.en: RNA is copied from DNA in a process called transcription.
examples.cn: 核糖核酸在称为转录的过程中从脱氧核糖核酸抄下。

examples.en: Some RNA molecules fold into shapes that catalyse reactions.
examples.cn: 有些核糖核酸分子折叠成能催化反应的形状。

examples.en: The test detects viral RNA in a sample.
examples.cn: 这项检测在样本中寻找病毒核糖核酸。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「阿尔恩埃」——比脱氧核糖核酸少一个氧，单链的「信差」：核糖核酸、传递遗传信息

root: 这是缩写，并非词根：全称由「核糖」「核酸」组合，其中「核酸」出自拉丁语 nucleus「核、果核」，「酸」出自拉丁语 acidus「酸的」；缩写于二十世纪中期通用，确切首见时间不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow the molecule from its chemistry to its messenger and machine roles, its viral use, its early-life hypothesis, its regulatory and medical uses, and its spelled-out name.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从化学分子出发，依次走向信使与机器角色、病毒用途、早期生命假说、调控与医疗用途，以及展开的全称。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a single strand copied from a template, leaving the nucleus to build a protein.
core.cn: 核心意象：一段单链从模板上被抄下，离开细胞核去建造蛋白质。

branches.en: THE NAME AND THE MOLECULE: the single strand, and the chemical name behind the initials.
branches.cn: 名称与分子：单链本身，以及首字母背后的化学全称。

branches.en: THE COURIER: a transcript carrying a gene's recipe.
branches.cn: 信差：携带基因配方的转录本。

branches.en: THE MACHINE AND THE VIRUS: RNA that builds protein, and viral genomes kept as RNA.
branches.cn: 机器与病毒：建造蛋白质的核糖核酸，以及以核糖核酸储存的病毒基因组。

branches.en: THE EARLY WORLD: a molecule that could both store and catalyse.
branches.cn: 早期世界：既能储存又能催化的分子。

branches.en: THE SWITCH AND THE DRUG: regulatory RNA, and RNA delivered as medicine.
branches.cn: 开关与药物：调控性核糖核酸，以及作为药物递送的核糖核酸。

intro.en: Like DNA, this word is an abbreviation whose parts come from chemistry rather than from old roots.
intro.cn: 与脱氧核糖核酸一样，这个词也是缩写，其部件来自化学命名而非古老词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies the nucleus and the acid; the sugar and the initials belong to modern chemistry.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供「核」与「酸」；糖与首字母属于现代化学。

items.example: It gives nucleic, the acid of the nucleus.
items.exampleCN: 它构成「核酸」。

items.example: It forms nucleic from nucleus.
items.exampleCN: 它由「核」构成「核酸的」。

items.example: It gives the final word of the full name.
items.exampleCN: 它构成全称末尾的「酸」。

items.example: It supplies the ribo- element.
items.exampleCN: 它提供「核糖」成分。

items.example: The initials are read letter by letter.
items.exampleCN: 这三个字母逐字母读出。

items.example: It forms RNase, an enzyme that cuts RNA.
items.exampleCN: 它构成「核糖核酸酶」。

items.example: It forms mRNA, the transcript.

items.example: It forms RNAi, the silencing pathway.
items.exampleCN: 它构成「核糖核酸干扰」。
